title: Thirdway hero
description: A 155svh opener: a full-window media layer pinned behind a gigantic two-line headline (56px phones, 120px desktop, weight 500, -0.06em) with a looping scroll cue. As you scroll, the media stays pinned, a statement on the right brightens character by character from 30% to 100% over a ground-darkening gradient, and the next section slides up over it.
notes: forces the dark colour scope: cream type over the photo, and the gradient fades to the theme's background
window-sized: 155svh, of which the first 100svh is the pinned media
the media slot should be a full-bleed video or photo (the original loops a video)
scroll-driven CSS: browsers without it show the statement fully lit
the sections that follow need an opaque background so they cover the pinned media
